newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 3.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Thursday:
* New York Gov. George Pataki said he would be willing to abandon key elements of his effort to overhaul the state's welfare system, a move that had been destined for defeat in the state Legislature.
* British Prime Minister Tony Blair's newly installed government has secured passage of its first budget, a package that included a tax cut for business.
* France has relented to the Clinton administration's push that NATO's expansion be limited to Poland, the Czech Republic and Hungary.
* The U.S. auto industry is in the midst of a fierce price war, offering a host of rebates, cut-rate loans and other discounts, making new cars more affordable than in nearly a generation.
* A new study produced by scientists at the National Cancer Institute and childhood leukemia experts finds no evidence that power lines cause leukemia.
* James Stewart, the soft-spoken actor who carried a dry wit and homespun charm, died at 89.
* Air Force Second Lieut. William Kite may be ousted for marrying Rhonda Kutzer, a former airman and now a civilian.
